pluscismte.title: Is M&TE
pluscismte.remarks: Defines whether a Tool is a standard used for measuring and testing equipment.

pluscisinhousecal.title: Internal Calibration
pluscisinhousecal.remarks: When selected, indicates that this tool is calibrated in house. This field can be used to sort tools that are calibrated internally or externally.

receipttolerance.title: Receipt Tolerance %
receipttolerance.remarks: The percentage value of items that can be received over the amount set in the initial agreement.

maxissue.title: Maximum Quantity Issued
maxissue.remarks: Total maximum quantity that can be issued to an asset.

groupname.title: Meter Group
groupname.remarks: Meter group for the item. This attribute pertains to rotating tools only. Click the Detail Menu button to select a meter group or go to the Meter Groups application to create one.

np_statusrolldown.title: Roll New Status to Organizations and Inventory
np_statusrolldown.remarks: Roll New Status to Organizations and Inventory, temporary non-persistent field used by MEA

taxexempt.title: Tax Exempt
taxexempt.remarks: Select this check box if the item, the tool, or the service is not taxable. The buyer for your organization determines the tax-exempt status of items, of tools, and of services.

itemnum.title: Tool
itemnum.remarks: Identifies the tool record. This value must be unique for all tool records. Click the Detail Menu button to view tools by classification or availability.

inspectionrequired.title: Inspect on Receipt
inspectionrequired.remarks: Specifies whether the tool should be held out of inventory when being received, until the purchase order receipt has been approved. If the check box is selected, the tool cannot be received until it has been inspected. If the check box is cleared (the default), the tool can be received without an inspection.

pluscismteclass.title: M&TE Classification
pluscismteclass.remarks: When the Is M&TE? field is checked then you have the option to choose a classification for M&TE.

metername.title: Meter
metername.remarks: Meter associated with the tool. This is the meter for which a reading is to be recorded when this tool is issued to an asset. Only non-rotating tools can be associated with a meter. Click the Detail Menu button to select a meter or go to the Meters application to create one.

outside.title: Outside
outside.remarks: Specifies whether the tool is a consignment good. If the check box is selected, the tool belongs to a contractor (or vendor), but it is stored on-site, and it is a tool for which you expect to be charged for its use. If the check box is cleared (the default), the tool is not owned by an outside party.

itemsetid.title: Item Set
itemsetid.remarks: Identifies the item set, or group of items, to which this tool belongs. An organization is assigned to only one item set, but multiple organizations can use the same item set. Click the Select Value button to choose an item set.

iscrew.title: Crew
iscrew.remarks: Specifies whether the tool can be used in Crew applications and Work Order Tracking applications. If the check box is selected, the tool can be used. If the check box is cleared, the tool cannot be used.

hardresissue.title: Requires hard reservation on use
hardresissue.remarks: Indicates whether a hard reservation must be referenced when the item is issued from a storeroom.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The current status of the item such as ACTIVE, PENDING, PLANNING, PENDOBS and OBSELETE.

commodity.title: Commodity Code
commodity.remarks: Commodity code identifying the category of tool. Click the Select Value button to choose a commodity code.

rotating.title: Rotating
rotating.remarks: Specifies whether the tool is a rotating asset. If the check box is selected, the tool becomes an asset tracked by tool number and individual asset number. If the check box is cleared (the default), the tool is not tracked as an individual asset.

hierarchypath.title: Hierarchy Path
hierarchypath.remarks: Sets value to HIERARCHYPATH, if the item has an associated CLASSSTRUCTURE record

commoditygroup.title: Commodity Group
commoditygroup.remarks: Group of commodities to which this tool belongs. Click the Select Value button to choose a commodity group.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes or names the tool. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button.

msdsnum.title: MSDS
msdsnum.remarks: Material Safety Data Sheet number issued by the Occupational Safety and Health Association (OSHA). The Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS), which describes product dangers, must be available to purchasers and users of commercial quantities of all hazardous materials.

issueunit.title: Issue Unit
issueunit.remarks: Unit of measure used to issue the tool from the storeroom, such as EACH or ROLL. Click the Select Value button to choose an issue unit.

orderunit.title: Order Unit
orderunit.remarks: Order unit used to create inventory records.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: Date the work order status was last changed.

statusiface.title: Has Status Changed
statusiface.remarks: Non persistent boolean field to indicate whether the status has been changed after the stateful object is fetched from the database.

np_statusmemo.title: Change Status Memo
np_statusmemo.remarks: Status change memo, temporary non-persistent field used by MEA
